$comment: The opt-in service table — ONE row per Polaris Key service, in canonical order, and the console's features over them. Core is not a service and has no row. `features` is the console's grouping (ST-38): each service row names its feature in `console.group`; a feature's switch writes every slug of its group except those a `service` switch of its own controls, which turn on with it by default. `setting` and `fact` switches are operator settings and read-only facts the console renders by id. `pnpm gen services` writes every language's slug constants from this file and the features to the console and the docs only (tools/gen-services.ts); `pnpm gen services --check` fails on drift. Adding a service starts here: see /docs/contribute/layout/#adding-a-service.
